g.text: Uno logical pin map: TXD to Uno D0; RXD to Uno D1. J1 pin map: module TXD goes to Uno D0/RX; module RXD is driven from Uno D1/TX through a suitable divider or level translator.

g.desc: Uno logical pin map: TXD to Uno D0; RXD to Uno D1. J1 pin map: module TXD goes to Uno D0/RX; module RXD is driven from Uno D1/TX through a suitable divider or level translator.

g.text: HC-05 breakout boards differ in regulator and input limits. Verify the exact board supply and RXD voltage before connecting. Physical Bluetooth link was not tested.
